description:
Goal

Make a callee return and its caller continuation use one exact transport contract after executable pruning and compaction, so a value produced as Absent is never delivered into a continuation that requires ValueRef.

Signal

With the RuntimeDemand Whole fallback removed, 00420_enum_take_drop_split reaches a real calling-convention mismatch: f191 returns an Absent carrier into f228 compact continuation entry 1, whose BackendReturnLayout requires ValueRef. The previously suspected EntryCapture namespace defect is disproved. EntryCapture construction maps compact entries through MaterializedExecutable.original_entry_ids; ABI and SymbolicBackendEntry positions for f191 original entry 4 are correct. The failing path is continue_backend_value materializing a callee return through MaterializedCallEdge.return_flow into the caller resume layout.

Strategy

Trace the exact callsite from callee ExecutableReturn through ReturnPayload and ResumePayload to BackendReturnLayout. Establish which producer or correlation lets the source and destination settle discordantly, then correct that identity/dependency upstream so both endpoints derive from one typed semantic contract. Preserve correlated shapes and original entry identities. Do not use Ty display strings, semantic equivalence, conservative Whole widening, compatibility shims, or consumer-side coercion.

TDD and acceptance

- First add a focused RED regression that constructs a pruned continuation whose demanded resume payload requires ValueRef while its callee return currently settles Absent.
- Prove the source and destination positions are tied to the same call-return flow and settle compatible carrier/layout facts.
- Prove unrelated return/resume flows and entry captures retain their exact generations/layouts.
- 00420_enum_take_drop_split passes interpreter, run, and build doors with no Absent/ValueRef mismatch.
- Existing transport-contract, runtime-demand, retained-product, fixture, determinism, formatting, clippy, and warning-denied gates pass.
- The final cause and invariant are documented in crisp names/tests; no contradictory historical comments remain.

Removal

Remove temporary diagnostics and the obsolete assumption or duplicate authority that allowed return and resume endpoints to disagree. Do not restore the RuntimeDemand unmatched-callable Whole fallback.
title: Preserve return and resume transport agreement across pruned continuations
